items.title: Sacred sites as refuges for native plant diversity in an urbanized tropical landscape
items.summary: Urbanization challenges plant communities. This study in Antananarivo, Madagascar, finds declines in the diversity of native, but not exotic, plants with greater urban intensity and that ‘sacred’ forest fragments supported the highest native plant diversity.

items.title: Energy system savings largely offset the costs of urban building energy efficiency improvements in China
items.display_title: Energy system savings largely offset the costs of urban building energy efficiency improvements in China
items.summary: This study analyzes the costs and benefits of urban building energy efficiency improvements in China from 2020 to 2050. The results reveal strong cost-effectiveness as well as a mismatch between who pays and who benefits, highlighting the need for policy intervention.

items.title: Effects of Uber and Lyft on jobs, wages and GDP
items.display_title: Effects of Uber and Lyft on jobs, wages and GDP
items.summary: Ride-hailing platforms such as Uber and Lyft are theorized to stimulate local economies. An analysis of 167 US cities reveals that their entry increased regional GDP and intermittent employment, but not overall jobs or earnings.

items.title: Inequities in geographic access to emergency obstetric and newborn care in Greater Accra
items.display_title: Inequities in geographic access to emergency obstetric and newborn care in Greater Accra
items.summary: Using travel data, this study reveals that while most women in Greater Accra, Ghana, can reach emergency obstetric care within 30 minutes, peri-urban and poorer areas face considerable geographic and socioeconomic access inequities.

items.title: Hidden patterns of urban mixing across five global cities
items.display_title: Hidden patterns of urban mixing across five global cities
items.summary: Using travel surveys from five global cities, this study explores how daily mobility shapes social mixing. Results show that activity spaces explain most place exposure variations, outweighing demographics and transit proximity.

items.title: The Indian street dog crisis and multispecies coexistence in tropical urban futures
items.display_title: The Indian street dog crisis and multispecies coexistence in tropical urban futures
items.summary: Cities in the Global South struggle with human–animal coexistence. This Perspective argues that, for free-ranging dogs in Indian cities, we are overlooking the ultimate issue, food subsidies that encourage and support dog packs and populations.

items.title: Mitigation of temperature-induced vegetable price volatility in urban wholesale markets
items.display_title: Mitigation of temperature-induced vegetable price volatility in urban wholesale markets
items.summary: Urban vegetable price stability under temperature extremes is poorly understood. Chen et al. show that thermal shocks drive wholesale price volatility, highlighting the need for targeted investments in resilient urban supply chains.
